title: Percentages

figures_added.what: Bar model of a £40 jacket split into four equal £10 blocks, one shaded amber as the 25% discount. Theme-safe: all text and strokes use currentColor, the discount block uses fill-opacity 0.3. viewBox 0 0 240 96, role=img with aria-label, no external refs, no xmlns http (validator-safe). Honours the show-what-you-say rule since the opener text refers to 'the bar'.

coverage_note: No bank problem in Percentages describes a printable figure. AQA GCSE prints no diagram for finding a percentage of an amount, percentage change, reverse percentages or compound interest: these are pure numeric items. Exam-realism test => no SVG/chart on any of the 20 bank questions (0 missed opportunities). The single figure is the opener bar model, added to make the concrete hook visual.
notes: Figure generated from the opener's own numbers (£40, four £10 blocks, 25% = one block). Re-read against the opener text: matches. No question text, solutions, guided steps, hints or misconceptions were changed in the diagram consideration.
